fields.description: When off, the Ask HR chatbot only ever uses the free, local, no-AI matching (exact keywords + typo-tolerant fuzzy match) - unrecognised questions get the fixed "here's what I can answer" list. When on, anything neither of those resolve is sent to Groq's free API - ONLY the question text, never any employee/HR data - purely to classify which known intent it maps to. Your own code still does the actual data lookup and writes the reply either way.
fields.label: Enable AI Fallback for Unmatched Questions

fields.description: Get a free key at https://console.groq.com/keys - no credit card required. Stored encrypted, never written to any file in the codebase.
fields.label: Groq API Key

fields.description: Must be a model actually available on your Groq account (check console.groq.com/playground) - Groq's free-tier catalog changes over time, so don't trust an old blog post's model name. Confirmed working here as of Aug 2026.
fields.label: Groq Model

fields.options: Actual live limit for this key, read from Groq's own response headers: 1,000 requests / 8,000 tokens per rate-limit window. Plenty for internal HR chatbot use - this is only called for questions the free local matching can't already resolve.

fields.description: Lets employees message ALIA on WhatsApp. Identity is verified by matching the sender's WhatsApp number against Employee.cell_number on file - no OTP step. Uses the same ask() pipeline as the desk widget (same AI/fixed-intent logic, same employee scoping), just a different channel in and out.
fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Channel

fields.description: From Meta's WhatsApp → API Setup page (developers.facebook.com), under your test number.
fields.label: WhatsApp Phone Number ID

fields.description: Temporary or permanent access token from the same API Setup page. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: WhatsApp Access Token

fields.description: A secret string you make up and enter here AND in Meta's webhook configuration (Verify Token field) - used only for the one-time webhook handshake.
fields.label: Webhook Verify Token

fields.description: From your Meta app's Basic Settings → App Secret. Used to verify every incoming webhook call really came from Meta (X-Hub-Signature-256), not to authenticate outgoing calls. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: App Secret

fields.options: Webhook URL to give Meta: this site's URL + /api/method/arjun_chatbot.api.whatsapp.webhook. In test mode, only WhatsApp numbers added as "recipient numbers" in Meta's dashboard can message this bot - up to 5, no business verification needed yet.
